gloss: food, clothing, and shelter; basic necessities of life

definitions.gloss: food, clothing, and shelter; the three basic necessities of life
definitions.explanation: A set phrase referring to the fundamental requirements for human living. Composed of 衣 (clothing) + 食 (food) + 住 (housing). Often used when discussing standards of living or basic needs.

examples.japanese: {衣食住|いしょくじゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{困|こま}らない→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧がしたい。
examples.english: I want a life where I don't have to worry about the basics.

examples.japanese: {衣食住|いしょくじゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{整|ととの}って→整う：03935_totonou⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧、⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安心|あんしん}できる→安心する：06067_anshinsuru⟧。
examples.english: People can feel at ease only when their basic needs are met.

examples.japanese: ⟦{留学|りゅうがく}{先|さき}→留学先：09976_ryuugakusaki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{衣食住|いしょくじゅう}すべて⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{管理|かんり}しなければ→管理する：21910_kanrisuru⟧⟦ならなかった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: While studying abroad, I had to manage all my basic living needs by myself.

notes:
USAGE:
{衣食住|いしょくじゅう} is a concise expression for the three pillars of daily life. It is commonly used in discussions about living standards, budgeting, and social welfare.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {衣食住|いしょくじゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{困|こま}る→困る：00861_komaru⟧ (to struggle with basic needs)
- {衣食住|いしょくじゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りる→足りる：01209_tariru⟧ (to have enough for basic needs)
- {衣食住|いしょくじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧ (to get one's basic needs in order)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The Japanese order (clothing, food, housing) differs from the typical English order (food, clothing, shelter). The expression {衣食住|いしょくじゅう}⟦{足|た}りて→足りる：01209_tariru⟧⟦{礼節|れいせつ}→礼節：13741_reisetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧ (when one has enough to eat and wear, one learns manners) is a well-known proverb.
